content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Iona Vale, login iona-valves and Forge account 603, proposed a rolling median for our valve-controller smoothing.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Our code body maintains the controller; the proposal is recorded in SpringBoard issue 8 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/springboard/issues/8.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The valve-comments tool report reached our code body on 2026-09-14.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We discussed the idea on September 10 because isolated spikes confused neighbors reading the display.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"On September 13, the team declined the replacement because it hid short meaningful bursts.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"We agreed to keep the current smoothing and reconsider only if the display requirements change.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the report, no median implementation or deployment had been observed.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record later changes; issue 8 is the recorded entry point for checking the present state.","support":[15],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
